evidence: Matches the 'Block storage' label and modifies block storage initialization in src/node/blockstorage.cpp to enforce directory locking.
rationale: Fixes a data corruption hazard where kernel consumers pointed at an active blocks directory silently overwrite existing block files from offset 0. Without locking in BlockManager, 'FlatFileSeq::Open opens in place with "rb+"' and 'the node keeps running and serves the overwritten bytes as its own blocks', compromising block storage integrity.
